run_finetune_ek100: run the LaViLa model fine-tuning on the EK100 classification dataset with a pretrained checkpoint
run_finetune_egtea: run the LaViLa model fine-tuning on the EGTEA dataset using a pretrained model checkpoint
run_validate_standard: run validation on a fine-tuned LaViLa model using the standard single-head VideoClassifier
run_validate_multihead: run validation on a fine-tuned LaViLa model using the multi-head verb-noun classifier
run_eval_only: run evaluation-only mode on a pretrained LaViLa model without training
